findings.correction: Retain the responding nameserver alongside each wire summary. Live NXDOMAIN, CNAME NXDOMAIN and NODATA use endpoint-aware response errors, distinct from cache errors. Family aggregation retains the original exceptions rather than Boolean flags.
findings.proof: The existing RFC2308 regression now checks all three live negative answers against the owned UDP peer, then repeats them from cache without a remote endpoint or new queries.
